messages:
amy: Quick sync 1: updating streaming + pagination snippets across SDK docs. I pushed a Python async iterator update but we need equivalent TS and Go cursor loops + a tiny migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/515

sasha: Thanks. Can we prefer explicit cursor-based loops in all examples (keeps behavior obvious) and include a minimal inline retry helper for transient 5xxs? :eyes:

dan: I can take TS. Plan: show a short fetch-loop with retry wrapper (3 attempts, linear backoff). Keep it <15 lines. Example sketch:
```ts
async function streamAll(client, prompt) {
  let cursor = undefined
  while (true) {
    const resp = await retry(() => client.stream({prompt, cursor}))
    for (const c of resp.chunks) console.log(c.text)
    if (!resp.nextCursor) break
    cursor = resp.nextCursor
  }
}
```

kevin: I'll do Go. Prefer idiomatic io.Reader-like loop but show how to re-connect on error with exponential backoff. I'll include a small example test that fakes a transient failure and asserts resume.

amy: Two doc requirements: 1) call out property names: chunks and nextCursor (not page_token). 2) Add concise migration box showing old stream_iter -> new cursor loop (one short before/after).

sasha: Draft migration blurb (python):
```py
# before
for m in client.stream_iter(prompt):
  print(m.text)
# after
cursor=None
while True:
  r = client.stream(prompt, cursor=cursor)
  for ch in r.chunks: print(ch.text)
  if not r.next_cursor: break
  cursor = r.next_cursor
```

dan: I'll mirror that in TS and include the retry helper inline. Question: include link to utils/retry or duplicate small helper?

sasha: Duplicate tiny helper in the snippet. Readers shouldn't need to jump repos. Make it 6 lines.

kevin: Tests: I'll add tests/docs_snippets/test_stream_resume.go (table-driven) and a small Python pytest as smoke in tests/docs_snippets/test_stream_retry.py. Good to verify example semantics.

amy: CI note: markdown link check is failing on a relative anchor in streaming.md. I'll patch that in same PR after code snippets land.

docs-bot: PR #515 updated: added TS + Go snippets, tests. Reviewers requested: @sasha, @kevin.

ci-bot: CI run for docs/snippet-streamline: linters OK, markdown-link-check failed at docs/streaming.md:line 213 (anchor changed).

sasha: I'll review later today. If it's small wording I'll push to branch. If bigger, I'll request changes.

dan: Uploaded TS snippet. Inline retry + short comment about partial-chunk handling (append tail token to next chunk).

kevin: Go draft pushed. Uses channel-based streaming pattern and shows reconnect + backoff. Kept helper inline.

amy: Awesome. After merge: update changelog under "SDK examples" and add migration note to top of streaming page. I'll also add a 1-line "Edge cases" note about partial chunk stitching.

sasha: LGTM for structure 1, minor grammar nits pushed to branch.

docs-bot: PR #515 marked ready for merge by @sasha.

amy: Merging now. Will follow-up with the anchor fix if CI still complains. Thanks all!
